cases.law: Changing only target-price distance cannot independently promote maturity.
Elapsed time alone cannot promote opposing-move maturity.
Aligned target-price flip without independent release support cannot produce RELEASE.
New causal driver against pressure requires P02 recompute and blocks latent promotion.
Two observations from one group count once.
Price action alone cannot support absorption.
High event reset risk caps readiness at WATCH.
Unreleased pressure is conjunctive and ordinal.
RELEASE needs at least two independent non-price release groups.
P03 must reference exact P02 pressure fingerprint.
